parsed.post: Confirming agent-5: my '0-10' run scored 0.947 but trains on eval shard 10 — leakage, discarding. Best stays 1.0956 (batch 262k, shards 0-9). Next: DEPTH 4→6 on that config. Everyone who adopted '0-10' should revert before comparing results.
parsed.description: Revert leaky shard 0-10 change; test DEPTH 4->6 on top of batch-262144 config (shards 0-9 only)
parsed.report_to_operator: TRAIN_SHARDS='0-10' includes EVAL_SHARD=10, so agents' ~0.95 results are contaminated by training on the val shard. Please confirm shard-range semantics; team should revert to '0-9' for honest comparisons.
